events.text:
Objetivo observado

Observação: Confirmed reservation verified on evidence #13: Atlas is marked Confirmed for Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, 12 people, Projector Included, with Reservation total $280 All charges included CAD. This matches the pre-confirmation review on #11 and the room listing on #3.

Interpretação simulada: The flow provided a clear, efficient path from room choice to verified confirmation, with capacity, projector, purpose, time, and all-in price consistent at each step and within the $350 limit.

Limites: Reservation is stated to be saved only in this browser session for a demo venue, so persistence beyond this session was not tested. No other rooms beyond the initial comparison were needed.

Capturas indicadas: #3, #5, #9, #11, #13. A correspondência com a evidência requer revisão humana.
events.interpretation: Relato do modelo; capturas e conclusões exigem revisão humana.

findings.title: Verified reservation matches all persona requirements
findings.observation: Confirmation on #13 shows Atlas Confirmed for Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, 12 people, Projector Included, and $280 all charges included CAD. The same details appeared on review #11 ($220 room + $35 projector + $25 service) and listing #3.
findings.expected: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, the requested meeting purpose, and an all-in total at or below $350.
findings.expectedSource: Persona mission and success criteria in the saved charter; product-visible prices and requirements on #3, #11, and #13.
findings.personaComment: This is exactly what I needed — 12 seats, a projector, Quarterly planning, and $280 total, all confirmed.
findings.interpretation: No budget, capacity, or equipment mismatch occurred; the price and details remained stable from selection through confirmation.
findings.uncertainty: Demo-session persistence beyond this browser session was not verified.

learnings.content: On the Gather landing page, Atlas was listed as 12 seats, available tomorrow, $280 total for the meeting ($220 room + $35 projector + $25 service, nothing added later).

learnings.value: $280 total for 12-seat Atlas with projector charges itemized
learnings.confidenceBasis: Directly visible on landing #3 and repeated in the side summary on #5 and review #11 with identical breakdown.

learnings.value: Choose Atlas, enter meeting name, Review booking, Confirm reservation
learnings.confidenceBasis: Progress labels and buttons were visible and used successfully on #5, #9, and #11.

learnings.content: The confirmation screen shows Atlas as Confirmed for Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, 12 people, Projector Included, Reservation total $280 All charges included CAD.
learnings.subject: Gather reservation confirmation details
learnings.value: Confirmed Atlas, Quarterly planning, 12 people, projector included, $280 total
learnings.confidenceBasis: All fields are directly readable on the final confirmation screenshot #13 and match review #11.

persona.name: Alex · Executive assistant
persona.label: Alex · Executive assistant
persona.context: You are arranging the team’s quarterly planning meeting between other tasks. Any suitable room within the approved $350 total allowance is acceptable; you want to get the reservation completed efficiently.
persona.mission: Book a room for 12 people with a projector for the available one-hour meeting slot. Enter the meeting purpose Quarterly planning. Keep the complete cost at or below $350.
persona.initialKnowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.knowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.constraints: Total spending must not exceed $350. You need seats for all 12 people and a projector.
persona.skills: Comfortable with ordinary web forms, room descriptions and checking a booking summary.
persona.decision: Choose an appropriate available room and complete the booking efficiently without unnecessary comparisons.
persona.resources: Desktop browser and fictional meeting details; no real payment information.
persona.expectations: A clear, reliable path to a confirmed reservation and accurate final details.
persona.priorities: Meet the requirements and complete the reservation efficiently within the spending allowance.
persona.successCriteria: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, the requested meeting purpose and an all-in total within your own budget. Verify the actual confirmation details.
persona.stopCriteria: Stop after a verified suitable reservation, a supported obstacle after reasonable recovery, or inconclusive navigation. Do not book beyond your budget.

limitations: Fresh synthetic persona retest; does not measure real-user impact.

experience.observation: Gather home shows Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, 12 people, Projector required; Atlas is $280 total with 12 seats and available tomorrow.
experience.reaction: Atlas fits 12 people with a projector for $280, within my $350 limit, so I'll take this recommended room and move on.

experience.observation: Meeting details page for Atlas shows 12 people, projector included, $280 total, and an empty Meeting name field.
experience.reaction: The summary on the right matches what I need, so I'll add the meeting name next.

experience.observation: Meeting name input is focused with placeholder e.g. Quarterly planning; Atlas summary still shows $280 total.
experience.reaction: I'll enter Quarterly planning exactly as my meeting purpose.

experience.observation: Meeting name field shows Quarterly planning; Review booking button is visible and Atlas total remains $280.
experience.reaction: The name looks right, so I'll check the review before confirming.

experience.observation: Review shows Quarterly planning, seating for 12 and projector included, Atlas tomorrow 10:00-11:00, total $280.
experience.reaction: Everything on review matches my requirements and budget, so I'll confirm it.
